title: The Fourth Page Manifests
next_chapter_hook: Su Qingyao pursued relentlessly, while the golden fragment hidden in Chen Ji's sleeve was quietly altering the fate trajectories of both.

text.content: When Chen Ji's fingertips touched the Jade Slip inscribed with the Chen family bloodline mark, a warm force surged into his palm, as if blood dormant for a thousand years was awakening within him. He felt his heart suddenly race, blood boiling through his vessels, some ancient power resonating with him.

Once more, a hazy image flickered through his mind—Chen Nian standing in a dark stone chamber, clutching an identical fragment. But this time, the vision was clearer than before; he could even perceive the tears glistening in his sister's eyes, and the silver veins rippling across the fragment's surface.

dialogue.content: Chen Nian... wait for me.

text.content: Suddenly, the Jade Slip in his palm radiated a soft golden light, the inscribed characters seeming to spring to life, twisting and reorganizing within the glow. Chen Ji sensed the Tianji Record in his embrace trembling slightly, as the seal on the fourth page gradually loosened, releasing an unprecedented wave of power.

He swiftly retrieved the Tianji Record, and the ancient pages began turning on their own, settling on a blank leaf. Moments later, faint golden characters emerged from the page's center, as if composed of flowing sunlight.

The Fourth Page Manifests: The Tianji Record comprises twelve pages in total; four are now revealed. To unseal the fifth page, one's most cherished possession must be sacrificed—whether bloodline, affection, or the bonds of destiny. An equivalent exchange; the heavenly way is eternal.

dialogue.content: The most cherished thing...

text.content: Chen Ji whispered those words, his voice echoing through the empty stone chamber. His gaze fell upon Chen Nian's blurred image, then he recalled Su Qingyao's bright eyes. A layer of cold sweat seeped through his palm. 'The most cherished thing'—these four characters pressed down on his heart like four great mountains.

Rapid calculations spun through his mind. If he sacrificed his feelings for Su Qingyao, he couldn't bear it; if he sacrificed his bloodline bond with Chen Nian, he could never do it. Both paths were dead ends, but a third option—his eyes flickered with a ruthless determination.

choice.prompt: The fourth page's unlock condition left Chen Ji deep in contemplation, forcing him to make a choice:

choices.text: Accept the price—regardless of who it is
choices.description: Since he chose this path, he must be prepared to sacrifice. Whether the cost is Su Qingyao or Chen Nian, he will not halt his steps.

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, gripping the Jade Slip tightly in his palm. Regardless of whose bond, he would accept it—as long as Chen Nian could return, as long as he could survive in this chaotic world.

dialogue.content: I accept.

choices.memory_label: 陈机接受了天机录的代价，展现出冷酷的一面

choices.text: Seek an alternative—there must be another way
choices.description: Since the Tianji Record is a divine artifact, it cannot have only one path. He must find that substitute—whether a great fortuitous encounter, or someone willing to bear the burden for him.
choices.risk_hint: Finding a substitute requires time and fortune

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze subtly hardened, his fingers gently tapping the Tianji Record's spine. In his mind, he was already arranging and combining various possibilities—how many secrets did Mo Xiansheng still conceal? Could Ye Qing use Demonic Path mists to obscure the Heavenly Secrets?

dialogue.content: Equivalent exchange? Hmph, let's see if there's any loophole under heaven that I can't find.

choices.memory_label: 陈机拒绝轻易牺牲，展现出他算无遗策的性格

choices.text: Not unlocking yet - verify the authenticity of information first
choices.description: The fourth page of the Tianji Record just appeared, whether the information is complete remains unknown. He needs to verify the authenticity of these conditions first before making a decision.

text.content: Chen Ji closed the Tianji Record and took a deep breath. The more significant the decision, the less hasty one should be. Since Mo Xiansheng brought him here, he must have another move prepared.

dialogue.content: No rush, the good show is still to come.

choices.memory_label: 陈机保持冷静，展现出他谨慎的一面

text.content: Just at this moment, a slight footstep echoed from the entrance of the stone chamber. Chen Ji's eyes turned cold, and he quickly stored the Tianji Record in his sleeve while his other hand swiftly picked up the Jade Slip from the ground. The moment he finished posing, a graceful figure appeared at the stone chamber entrance.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji? What are you doing here!

text.content: Su Qingyao wore a moon-white long dress, with three parts anger and seven parts vigilance in her brow. She stared at Chen Ji, her gaze like a sharp blade, seemingly wanting to see through him. The candlelight in the stone chamber flickered, stretching the two figures long.

dialogue.content: Senior Sister Su? It's so late, why are you here?
I should be asking you! This is a forbidden area of our Tianqing Sect. How did a servant disciple like you get in here?

text.content: Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his face maintained that honest and simple appearance. He knew Su Qingyao had been secretly investigating him - this woman's intuition was too sharp, any carelessness would expose his flaws.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao pressed closer step by step, Chen Ji needs to respond:

choices.text: Play dumb - can't let the废物persona collapse
choices.description: Continue playing the role of a cowardly servant disciple who knows nothing, using innocence to dissolve Su Qingyao's suspicion.

dialogue.content: Senior Sister Su, I-I just got lost... I really don't know anything!

choices.memory_label: 陈机继续伪装，但苏青瑶的疑心越来越重

choices.description: Reveal some trivial information, like searching for clues about the Chen family, but never mention the Tianji Record or the fourth page.

dialogue.content: Senior Su, I won't hide it from you—I'm looking for clues about the Chen family... I have a sister who's been missing for years, and she might be connected to this.

choices.memory_label: 陈机透露了部分真相，开始建立信任

choices.text: Retreat to advance—turn the tables and interrogate Su Qingyao
choices.description: Don't answer directly, instead question Su Qingyao's purpose for coming here late at night, and seize back the initiative.

dialogue.content: Senior Su, your question is interesting. I might ask—what brings the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow to the Forbidden Grounds alone at this late hour?

choices.memory_label: 陈机展现出强势的一面，让苏青瑶刮目相看

text.content: Su Qingyao stepped forward, her beautiful eyes carrying a hint of cold intent. Her gaze swept across Chen Ji and the surrounding stone walls, when she suddenly noticed the scattered Jade Slip fragments on the ground.

dialogue.content: What is that thing in your hand? Show me!

text.content: Chen Ji instinctively hid the Jade Slip into his sleeve. To Su Qingyao's eyes, this action was like admitting guilt where none existed. Her pupils constricted sharply, and an imperceptible pressure unique to the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow emanated from her body.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, what secrets are you hiding? From the moment you entered the Tianqing Sect, I've felt something was off about you!

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao pressed closer relentlessly, and the relationship between Chen Ji and her faced a test:

choices.text: Hold the bottom line—never let her know
choices.description: No matter how Su Qingyao pressured him, the secret of the Tianji Record could not be revealed. This was his foundation for survival, and also the key to his grand scheme for the world.
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao might take more drastic measures

dialogue.content: Senior Su, you and I are both disciples of the Tianqing Sect. Some things... it's not that I won't tell you, but speaking of them would only bring harm to you.

choices.memory_label: 陈机坚持不透露秘密，但给出了模糊的解释

choices.text: Reveal strategically—draw her into the game
choices.description: Su Qingyao is too persistent. It would be better to draw her into his own chess game. This way he could gain a reliable helper while dissolving her hostility.
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao might not be able to accept it

dialogue.content: Senior Su, you truly want to know? Then prepare yourself—you're about to see something that might overturn your entire perception.

choices.memory_label: 陈机决定向苏青瑶透露部分真相，两人的关系进入新阶段

text.content: At the moment when the atmosphere was about to solidify, the fragment in Chen Ji's sleeve suddenly emitted a faint golden light. This radiance, visible even through the clothing, shone like stars in the night sky within the dim stone chamber. Su Qingyao's beautiful eyes widened abruptly, her expression frozen in an instant.

dialogue.content: This is... the aura of the Tianji Record?!

text.content: Chen Ji's heart sank; he hadn't expected to slip up at this critical moment. He quickly pressed the fragment back into his sleeve, but Su Qingyao had already caught that fleeting glow. Her gaze shifted, transforming from the earlier skepticism to an incredulous shock.

dialogue.content: You... you're actually a Prophet?!

text.content: Chen Ji looked at Su Qingyao's shocked expression, his heart filled with mixed emotions. The waste persona he had meticulously maintained for three years had cracked significantly at this moment. He knew that from now on, the relationship between him and Su Qingyao would change completely.

dialogue.content: Senior Sister Su, you've seen something you shouldn't have.
Then what do you plan to do? Kill me to keep me silent?

text.content: Chen Ji let out a helpless sigh, a helpless curve forming at the corner of his lips. He knew Su Qingyao wasn't the type to be intimidated by threats, otherwise she wouldn't have become the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow. This woman was far more troublesome than he had imagined.
Killing you gains me nothing but another enemy. Senior Sister Su, neither of us is foolish. Some things are better left unsaid. What you want to know, I can tell you part of it—but not now, not here.

dialogue.content: When? Where?

text.content: Chen Ji turned around, gazing at the dark night sky outside the stone chamber. The moonlight was like water, spilling across his side profile, outlining a cold and sharp silhouette. He knew that from this moment on, the relationship between him and Su Qingyao could never return to what it was. But that was fine, too. Some things were too exhausting to carry alone.

Three days later, the bamboo grove at the back mountain. I will tell you everything—including the secrets of the Tianji Record, why I'm at the Tianqing Sect—and also the answer you've always wanted to know.

Su Qingyao stared at his back for a long time before finally h冷哼一声，转身离开了石室。Her footsteps faded into the distance, and only then did Chen Ji slowly exhale. He lowered his head to look at the faintly glowing fragment in his sleeve, the golden characters on the fourth page having gradually faded, leaving only a faint halo.

The thing I cherish most, huh... he murmured to himself, a resolute glint flickering in his eyes. Whether it's Chen Nian or Su Qingyao, I won't abandon either of them. Since the Tianji Record demands a price, I'll find something that can replace it—if I can't find it, I'll destroy this rule.

Night wind blew in from the stone chamber entrance, bringing chilling waves of cold. Chen Ji stored the Tianji Record carefully and walked out of the stone chamber, standing under the moonlight. His shadow stretched long in the moonlight, appearing somewhat lonely. But he knew this was merely the calm before the storm. The real test still lay ahead.

Su Qingyao's figure had already vanished into the night, but Chen Ji knew she must be watching him from somewhere. This woman's persistence exceeded his expectations. But that was fine too—some things always needed someone trustworthy to share the burden— even if he still wasn't certain whether Su Qingyao could become that person.

He raised his head, gazing at the distant night sky. The chess game of fate had already unfolded, and every move he made with his pieces walked on the edge of a blade. One misstep meant utter destruction. But he did not regret, because behind him stood the people he wanted to protect.

The appointment three days later would determine the future between him and Su Qingyao. And the secret revealed on the fourth page pressed on his heart like a massive boulder—the consumption of Heavenly Fate, the price of the most cherished thing, Chen Nian's whereabouts—all these intertwined, forming a deadly knot he must unravel.

Just as he was about to leave the stone chamber, an aged voice suddenly came from behind him: "Boy, you've finally reached this point." Chen Ji turned sharply, only to see a phantom figure floating in mid-air—that was the projection of Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul.

dialogue.content: The price of the fourth page, you must have seen it by now, right?
Mister Mo, you knew about this all along?

What does knowing change? What does not knowing change? What must come will come. You can't change Heavenly Dao, you can only change yourself. Remember, boy—equivalent exchange, but it doesn't have to mean loss. Sometimes, sacrifice can take another form.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's figure gradually faded, leaving only his final words echoing in the stone chamber: "Three days later, you'll understand." Chen Ji stared at that void, a glint of comprehension flashing in his eyes. Mo Xiansheng never spoke nonsense; if he said this, it meant there was still room for change.

He took out the Tianji Record again, looking at the golden characters on the fourth page that were gradually fading. A smile curved at the corner of his lips—the rules of the Tianji Record he could not change, but how to interpret those rules was up to him. Three days was enough time to lay out a scheme that could deceive even heaven.

Night wind lifted the corner of his robe, and Chen Ji stepped away from the stone chamber under the moonlight. His footsteps were steady and resolute, and in his heart, he had already begun calculating his next plan. Su Qingyao's appearance had disrupted his rhythm, but she would also become a key piece in his chess game—provided he could convince her to stand on his side.

In a dark corner outside the stone chamber, Su Qingyao quietly watched Chen Ji's departing figure. Her eyes flickered with complex emotions—both a yearning for truth and a curiosity about Chen Ji himself. This seemingly worthless servant disciple harbored too many secrets she couldn't comprehend.

"Three days later?" she murmured softly to herself, a flash of determination in her eyes. No matter who he was or what his purpose, she was determined to find out. On this man was an aura she had never seen before—a confidence that could control the overall situation even in the most desperate circumstances.

The night wind howled as Chen Ji vanished into the darkness. Silence reclaimed the stone chamber, with only a faint glimmer from the Jade Slip fragment catching the moonlight. In the unknowable depths, the seal on the Tianji Record was slowly loosening, and content from the fourth page had begun to emerge—the secret of "equivalent exchange" awaited Chen Ji to uncover.
